coverage.tracks: Road centre plus four authoritative Taycan wheel centres in every logical lane, excluding only the first/last 2m where cross-road continuation is validated separately.
coverage.surfaceQuery: Actual CityGround.sampleRoadSurface with rendered-floor height reference; topology and layer selection unchanged. Grounded/rejection/impulse data come from the separate dynamic replays.
coverage.render: Existing RoadEdgeChain ribbon triangles and junction surfaces; excludes the intentional 24mm visual paint lift. Float32 render-vertex comparison recorded separately.
coverage.headless: All authored road/junction pavements retained. Only furniture and visual terrain extents reduced; terrain-return queries are flagged as missing pavement and excluded from the height-error statistic.

rootCause: Legacy segment-plane contact did not match rendered mitered ribbon on curved graded roads. Fifteen short inverted strips and one outer wheeltrace twisted corner additionally required bounded C1 XZ repair. Existing ribbon contact data was enabled; vehicle physics and support selection were not changed.
